claim: You can restore a DB instance to a specific point in time from a replicated backup; in the console you choose the destination Region (where backups are replicated to), and you restore the DB instance in the destination Region.

evidence.quote: You can restore a DB instance to a specific point in time from a replicated backup using the Amazon RDS console.
Choose the destination Region (where backups are replicated to) from the Region selector.
Then restore the DB instance in the destination Region and associate the custom option group with it.
